The programs aim to turn real-world data into AI models that can autonomously control physical systems such as sensors, industrial equipment, and robots, tying the company’s work to regional manufacturing and infrastructure use cases.

title: A3 Expands Introduction to Industrial Robotics Course with Business Case for Automation
summary: A3 has added an ROI-focused business case module to its Introduction to Industrial Robotics course, teaching learners how to judge when automation is economically justified rather than just technically feasible. The update matters because it frames robotics adoption around concrete decision factors like where automation fits, when it pays off, and how to evaluate investments in industrial settings.

title: Robotic lab sets up and runs optics experiments on demand
summary: An autonomous robotic lab can set up and run optics experiments on demand, aiming to accelerate how researchers test high-tech materials. The system matters because optical characterization is central to developing solar cells, sensors, displays, and quantum technologies, where faster experiment setup and iteration could shorten the path from candidate material to usable device.

extra.full_text: The autonomous system could speed up testing of high-tech materials for applications such as solar cells, sensors, video displays, and quantum technologies.

title: Helix 2.5: Zero-Shot 30-Home Generalization
summary: Figure introduced Helix 2.5, its newest neural-network model for humanoid robotics, framed around zero-shot generalization across 30 different homes. The announcement suggests a push toward robots that can transfer household manipulation and navigation behavior into unfamiliar real-world environments without per-home retraining, though the supplied text does not include task details, metrics, or evaluation results.

summary: GIST researchers developed a robot-AI system that can identify not just objects in its surroundings, but functional parts such as handles and buttons and what those parts are used for. The point is practical manipulation: a robot that knows where a microwave is still cannot heat food unless it can locate the handle to open the door and understand which controls operate it.

title: “글로벌 4족보행 로봇 시장, 2030년까지 중국이 '절반' 차지”
summary: Frost & Sullivan’s 2026 white paper forecasts a sharp expansion in the global quadruped robot market, with revenue rising from about 300 million yuan in 2023 to 2.3 billion yuan in 2025 and potentially 53 billion yuan by 2030. China is expected to drive much of that growth and account for roughly half of the global market by 2030, underscoring how quickly Chinese robotics firms are moving from niche deployments toward large-scale industrial and commercial adoption.

title: ABZ Innovation Opens One of Europe's Largest Civilian Drone Manufacturing Facilities
summary: ABZ Innovation has opened a major civilian drone manufacturing facility in Szentendre, Hungary, aimed at scaling European production of agricultural and industrial drone systems. The move matters because it adds regional manufacturing capacity in a sector where drones are increasingly used for precision spraying, monitoring, mapping, and other field operations, reducing reliance on overseas supply chains.

summary: AI cooking-robot company Aniai has signed a service partnership with SK Networks Service to build a nationwide installation and maintenance network for its Alpha Grill Single robot. The move is meant to support wider rollout across restaurants and foodservice sites, including Lotteria, Frank Burger, Korean barbecue and meat-focused venues, and CJ Freshway cafeterias, where faster, more standardized after-sales support becomes important as deployments scale.

summary: Kyung Hee University’s Hyo-seok Hwang will lead a new AI autonomous cerebrovascular intervention robotics lab, backed by 1.5 billion won over three years through Korea’s 2026 BRL program. The project brings together software, mechanical engineering, and medical collaborators, including Korea University Medicine, the University of Toronto, and SickKids, to develop robotic systems in which AI supports decision-making for brain blood-vessel procedures.

title: AMD, 연내 국내에 '아시아 첫' AI 우수 연구센터 설립…과기부와 공동연구 본격화
summary: AMD plans to open its first Asian AI Center of Excellence in Korea by the end of the year, using it as a base for joint research with the Korean government, universities, institutes, and companies. The collaboration is expected to cover AI talent development and applied research in drug discovery, climate, energy, manufacturing, robotics, and other physical-AI domains, building on a July meeting between AMD CEO Lisa Su and Korea’s science ministry.

title: Leopard Imaging to Showcase Advanced Embedded Vision Solutions with Future Electronics at World of Technology & Science 2026
summary: Leopard Imaging will demonstrate embedded vision hardware with Future Electronics at World of Technology & Science 2026, covering stereo vision, thermal imaging, high-performance camera systems, and ultra-compact imaging modules. The focus is on deployable vision components for robotics, autonomous systems, industrial automation, AIoT, and edge AI, so the relevance is less a single algorithmic advance than a compact hardware stack aimed at bringing perception into real-world machines.
